description: Search Best Buy by keyword or scrape product URLs directly. Each result is a structured record with SKU, prices, rating, model, and availability.

keyword.description: Free-text search — product name, brand, category. Leave empty if you're using `productUrls` instead.
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxResults.description: Hard cap on records emitted across keyword search + URL scrape.
maxResults.title: Max results

productUrls.description: Specific Best Buy product page URLs to scrape (e.g. `https://www.bestbuy.com/site/.../6505729.p?skuId=6505729`). Used in addition to / instead of `keyword`.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

skipOutOfStock.description: Drop products marked `out of stock` / `sold out` by Best Buy.
skipOutOfStock.title: Skip out-of-stock

title: Best Buy Scraper Input
